title: Extending the Formalism and Theoretical Foundations of Cryptography to AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on the cryptographic and formal security foundations of agentic AI systems, such as confidentiality, integrity, and availability. While it discusses 'harmlessness' as a design objective and a component of its formal 'AIOracle' model, it treats ethics as an abstract predicate (variable) rather than evaluating or benchmarking specific ethical frameworks, religious values, or moral reasoning.
